decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-b47e5003a748]. It says that "known interim resources" are now excluded by default and marks the change as breaking (the "!"). It does not say which resource kinds count as "interim", which configuration key or default carries the exclusion list, or what an operator who relies on those resources would see. To write the subject and applicability, we need the referenced PRs (#20013/#21635) or the 3.0 upgrade guide entry that lists the excluded resources and the setting that controls them.
